recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No additional FHIR-core source change is needed for FHIR-49614; future Procedure.report or circular-reference guidance work should remain in the separate Procedure/Patient Care workflow.
issue_request: FHIR-49614 was an Applied/Persuasive OO FHIR-core DiagnosticReport change request for R6 asking to add DiagnosticReport.procedure as 0..* Reference(Procedure), with short text about the procedure(s) from which the report was produced, a definition saying the procedure(s) are reported on in the DiagnosticReport, and a procedure search parameter.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation through HL7/fhir PR #3422. Commit 388fdf54d added DiagnosticReport.procedure and DiagnosticReport-procedure, commit 3614bdd7 adjusted the short display punctuation, and merge commit a0ddfed31e brought the FHIR-49614 changes into the build.
additional_context: DiagnosticReport is active in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-50866 kept DiagnosticReport.procedure and clarified it as the performed procedure; FHIR-50887 rejected adding DiagnosticReport.partOf because .procedure was kept; FHIR-53214 separately changed DiagnosticReport search parameters including procedure to active/normative. Those related decisions are already represented on the combined branch. Patient Care/OO discussion about Procedure.report deprecation and circular-reference guidance remains separate and does not reverse the seed decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition has DiagnosticReport.procedure as 0..* Reference(Procedure) with performed-procedure wording, and the DiagnosticReport search-parameter bundle has an active reference search parameter with code procedure and expression DiagnosticReport.procedure.
